strategy: Use discovery campaigns to find search terms, graduate terms with demonstrated conversions to exact match, retain controlled broad-match exploration, and reduce bids or flag negatives only after sufficient evidence. No ad API or spending is used.

metric_formulas.ctr: taps / impressions when both columns exist and impressions > 0
metric_formulas.conversion_rate: conversions / taps when both columns exist and taps > 0
metric_formulas.cpa: spend / conversions when both columns exist and conversions > 0

decision_rules: At least minimum_conversions_for_exact conversions and CPA at or below target_cpa: recommend adding or retaining exact match and raise an available bid incrementally, capped by maximum_bid and maximum_bid_increase_fraction.
Converting terms without a reliable CPA retain exact-match recommendations but do not receive an increase.

Terms with at least minimum_taps_for_conversion_assessment taps, zero conversions, and spend at or above minimum_spend_for_negative_review: recommend exact-match negative review in discovery/broad and decrease an available bid; no automatic exclusion occurs.
Terms with taps but insufficient conversions remain broad/discovery candidates with no bid increase.
If total spend is at or above budget_cap, suppress all increases and recommend holding or reducing bids.
Low CTR is reported only with enough impressions; it informs review rather than acting as a standalone pause rule.
